title: fix(studio): permission matrix draws its flat form only where it fits
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87U6WT6cWKNyvpePUBtWW1w)_

Fixes #36744

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在 Studio「权限 → 对象权限」里，不论窗口多宽，最右边的批量操作列都不会再压住「写入范围」列：放得下完整表格时才铺开全部十列，放不下时（如 1440 px 笔记本）改用已有的折叠形态（增删改查四列 +「更多权限」+「批量」菜单）。
- 属于体验区（area:ux）的界面缺陷修复，来自 11-23 Studio 评审第 r06 项。
- 出错的话只是某个宽度下显示折叠形态还是平铺形态，不改任何权限数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The Studio Objects matrix (`StudioObjectMatrix` in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`) has two forms, picked by a CSS container query on its scroll pane (`permissionMatrixFold.ts`). The flat form switched on at a 1000 px pane, but its table floor (`PERM_MATRIX_TABLE_FLOOR`) is 1304 px. Between the two the flat table overflowed the pane and the right-pinned bulk column (`STICKY_BULK_CELL`) sat over the write-scope column, with nothing to show the pane scrolled sideways. A 1440 px window gives a 1200 px pane, inside that band.

- `permissionMatrixFold.ts`: new `PERM_MATRIX_FLAT_FLOOR = 1304` (object column + 1040 px of fixed columns: record-access badge `w-28`, eight boxes at 52 px, two scope pickers `w-36`, bulk strip `w-56`); `PERM_MATRIX_FOLD_WIDTH` is now that constant. The five class literals move from `@min-[1000px]:` to `@min-[1304px]:` (literals, because Tailwind scans source text).
- No change in `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`; the metadata-admin `PermissionTable` (Setup, environment scope) does not fold and is untouched.
- The card's alternative (lower the floor by using the Bulk menu in the flat form too) was not taken: the folded form at 1440 px reads correctly in the browser (frames below), which was the card's condition for proposing it.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

- `PermissionMatrixEditor.fold-35061.test.tsx`, new case "the fold width is the flat table floor, so the flat form never overflows the pane": `PERM_MATRIX_FOLD_WIDTH === PERM_MATRIX_FLAT_FLOOR`, and `PERM_MATRIX_TABLE_FLOOR` reads `@min-[<fold>px]:min-w-[<floor>px]`. The existing "every class string names the fold width" case now expects 1304.
- Reverse verification: with `permissionMatrixFold.ts` restored from `origin/main` (plus the new export so the file imports), both of those cases fail; the other five pass. Restored from HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `ui/e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts` (Chromium geometry): the Studio 1000 px "scrolled" case is gone (that pane is now folded and does not scroll); the Studio folded case runs at 720 and 1200 px; a new case at a 1304 px pane asserts the flat form is drawn (no "More permissions" toggle), nothing scrolls, and every box answers.

Local runs at `b150025f` (the dependency closure built first):

```
pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.fold-35061.test.tsx
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)

pnpm --dir ui exec playwright test e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts --trace off
 chromium + Mobile Chrome: 14 passed
 firefox / webkit / Mobile Safari: not run here (browsers not installed in the container: "Executable doesn't exist")
```

Full package suite and the lint gates run in this PR's checks.

## Acceptance notes

- None.

## Verification

Browser, showcase app, Studio → Access → Showcase Contributor → Object permissions, zh-CN, on `b150025f`. Measured on `[data-testid=perm-matrix-pane]` and `[data-testid=perm-studio-matrix]`:

| Window | Pane width | Pane scrollWidth | Table width | Form drawn |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1440 px | 1200 | 1200 | 1200 | folded (「更多权限」column shown) |
| 1920 px | 1680 | 1680 | 1680 | flat (all ten columns, scopes, strip) |

At both widths the pane does not scroll sideways and no column is covered. Frames (`after-1440-zh.png`, `after-1920-zh.png`) are attached in the project thread; the review's before frame is `round2/r06`.
